title: My first game in Play ever.  Great Lakes, USA
author: National_Yellow_8872
selftext:
A lot of AI went into making this happen. Would love to hear from players that like fishing games how to improve fishing mechanics. I made sure that all the data in the app is correct up to the ratio of fish that have lampreys bite marks earning less coins. 

The game started with research and the creation of a persona above a Claude model that got skills of a marine biologist and asked to do the reasearch. Fish were created with Codex imagen to make front, back and side images and an agent tripo workflow to create the fish. Codex is also extremly good at fixing small 3d errors like splitting fins.

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gamaedor.greatlakesfishing](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gamaedor.greatlakesfishing)
